make.description: The manufacturer or brand of the infrared camera (e.g., FLIR, Testo, Fluke, Seek Thermal).

model.description: The specific product designation given by the manufacturer, identifying the type or version of the infrared camera (e.g., FLIR E8-XT, Testo 865, Fluke Ti480 Pro).

serialNumber.description: A unique identifier assigned by the manufacturer to distinguish an individual infrared camera unit, typically used for traceability, calibration records, or warranty purposes.

x.description: The camera resolution in pixels, represented as width.

y.description: The camera resolution in pixels, represented as height.

maximum.description: Maximum wavelength measured by camera's sensor, which determines the type of thermal radiation it can detect

minimum.description: Minimum wavelength measured by camera's sensor, which determines the type of thermal radiation it can detect

maximum.description: Maximum temperature measured by the camera

minimum.description: Minimum temperature measured by the camera

emissivity.description: The emissivity value used for temperature calculations, representing the efficiency with which a surface emits thermal radiation.

framerate.description: The rate at which the camera acquires thermal data, typically measured in Hertz (Hz) or frames per second (fps)
